tasks.behavior: Process diagrams follow the conventions readers expect: a rework loop no longer drags its repair step in front of the work it repeats, and a decision's branches leave the diamond by different vertices. The exported HTML reads as a document rather than a debug view: it names the diagram, drops the editing affordances, and stops magnifying a small diagram.
acceptance: No decision branch is drawn right to left; only the leg that returns to an earlier step runs backwards.
In the CI/CD and approval templates the rework step is drawn after the check that asks for it.
A decision's outgoing branches leave by different vertices when their targets are above and below it.
An exported HTML view names the diagram, and never draws port dots.
Fit in the exported view never enlarges a small diagram past its own size.
The exported legend reads as a panel, not as text loose on the page.
The README no longer carries a portable-view section.
